finish.policy: map actual game outcome enum explicitly; stop previous sounds first, then play one result cue; if rescue and finish coexist in same drainEvents batch, suppress rescue audio and prefer result cue

reaction_policy: player only, max once per 1500ms, skip during result and loud SFX; synthetic nonverbal motifs not voice recordings
pause: stop all active sources; resume only from user gesture; do not replay drained events
loop: use decoded WAV AudioBuffer sample-accurate full-length looping; OGG alternate requires target-browser decode-length check; HTML looping only a listening preview
